families_note: v0.1 recipes unchanged; faceted_cylinders/faceted_spheres/rounded_boxes/curved_walls/mixed_irregular measured and excluded (GEOMETRY_DIVERSITY.md)

sources.prior: iid Uniform(D(G)), D(G)=FREE with certified clearance > 2^-26

acceptance: all sources outside closed box AND FREE>0 AND m>=1, then U < c(m,L,k)
effective_layer: channel has >=1 lit FREE and >=1 dark FREE receiver in the window
training_weight: omega = Lambda_hat_L(scene) per (scene, side), from the rate stream

labels.representation: sparse records (cell int32 in 128^3, lo, hi float64, kind int8) + tv_bound

splits: sha256(scene_id) mod 100: <80 train, <90 val, else test
